description: 20:15 - 21:30: POOH from 2359m to 2335m and circulated bottom up with 1350l/min 53bar and then increased to 2020l/min 109bar. In the end of circulation some loose cement was observed in the shakers along with consolidated clumps of cement. Otherwise mostly clean fluid in returns. Meanwhile recalculated BHA figures after discrepancy was found
